method: Batch 45 (creeperwitch): the batch 44 harness plus a fifth row element [explosions [x,y,z,size,flaming,smoking,push], spawned items/orbs/potions, changed cells, player motion] recorded by a World.newExplosion override and the world random reseeded per record; creeper flags [state, fuse, lastActive, powered, ignited] and witch flags [drinking, timer, held potion, movement speed]. Creepers (fuse, flint and steel, lightning, power 3 and 6, mobGriefing, difficulty, damage and knockback, drops, a skeleton arrow kill) and witches (potion choice, throws on the potion own random, self drinking, drops). Mobs spawned mid-run are never ticked. Unchanged classes on the VillageLiveProbe double (no village), the player a real EntityPlayerMP (ServerPlayerProbe), every mob ticked by Entity.onUpdate. Per tick: [mob rows [x,y,z,health,target index,revenge index,flags,draws], sounds, player health lost, player revenge index, player ticks]; the player has index types.length. See EndermanWolfProbe.java for types and script ops.
